sections.title: Markets We Serve
sections.text: Localized products, certification and payment for Africa & India.

sections.title: Power Through the Grid Gaps
sections.text: With unstable grid supply, Nigerian homes and businesses rely on solar + storage. We supply 48V hybrid inverters and LiFePO4 batteries sized for local loads, with SONCAP documentation support.

sections.title: Solar for Homes & Off-Grid Sites
sections.text: Kenya's abundant sunshine makes solar ideal. We support KEBS-certified shipments and mobile-money payment for fast, low-friction ordering.

sections.title: Make in India Ready
sections.text: India's rooftop solar push is driving huge demand for inverters and storage. We provide BIS-ready products and support UPI / Razorpay payments and Cash on Delivery.

sections.title: Distributor or Retailer?
sections.text: Ask about regional pricing, containers and local warehouse support.
